items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: My brother Eddie was next to Wilmore.

ctx.x: young to know what... My mother used to take in washing and ironing to keep us...to help raise us, you know. She did that kind of... There was two or three of us, myself and my brother Eddie. Of course, I was the youngest one. I was about, oh, three or four years older [sic] than my brother. That's the only one who's living, is my brother -- he's living in North Carolina. I guess he must be now around 85 years old.
